note: Single source of truth for the lifecycle chart palette (design §7.6). The CSS lifecycle ramp in app.css is generated from `lifecycle_ramp.colors`; validate_palette.js reads THIS file so the check and the shipped ramp can never drift. `frames_5hue` is the wireframes' original set, kept ONLY so the validator can demonstrate the CVD failure it was rejected for — it is never shipped to a surface.

lifecycle_ramp.kind: single-hue sequential (lifecycle is a progression, not five identities — §7.6)

frames_5hue.kind: REJECTED — five distinct hues; #3366FF vs #7a5cff are protan-indistinguishable at ΔE 0.4 (§7.6). Present only as the validator's negative fixture.

gold.meaning: the human gate (⟡) — a reserved semantic, never a series colour (§7.6)
